# Test: grove list rejects status filters that --fast never populates
setup_workspace

! exec grove list --fast --filter dirty --plain
stderr '^Error: --filter dirty cannot be used with --fast because status checks are skipped$'
! stderr 'Gathering worktree status'
! stdout .

! exec grove list --fast --filter locked,ahead --plain
stderr '^Error: --filter ahead cannot be used with --fast because status checks are skipped$'

# locked is known without status checks, so it still works with --fast
exec grove list --fast --filter locked --plain
